summary: Devices join a fleet when their labels match the fleet's selector, e.g. type=pos-terminal for all terminals or type=pos-terminal,stage=development for a dev fleet; selectors must not overlap, and if two fleets select the same device it stays in its current fleet.
questions: How are devices assigned to fleets?
How do I split devices into dev and production fleets?
What happens if two fleet selectors match the same device?
